Prevent bugs where callers silently ignore failure and use uninitialized or invalid output data.

result.summary: This PR annotates legacy getter functions returning a bool status alongside a mutable reference with the C++17 [[nodiscard]] attribute. It updates or asserts call sites across the codebase where return values were previously ignored, including in descriptor caching and script interpretation.
result.problem: Legacy getter patterns allow callers to inadvertently ignore false return values and inspect uninitialized or invalid out-parameters, leading to subtle logic bugs across the codebase.

result.card: This PR adds C++17 [[nodiscard]] attributes to legacy getter functions that return a boolean success flag alongside an out-parameter by mutable reference, preventing callers from accidentally ignoring failures. It updates call sites across multiple subsystems to ensure return values are either handled or asserted. While reviewers broadly support the concept as a solid static-analysis safeguard against subtle bugs, the PR is currently in draft with failing CI and has seen no author activity for four months. It is an internal refactoring that does not substantively alter wallet, validation, or RPC subsystem behavior.
